rationale: Micah is building IntentiveAI with a focus on visual intuition for machine learning systems and interactive data visualization as the interface between AI and human decision-making—exactly the kind of applied ML work Alex is actively exploring through machine learning bootcamp programs. Alex's Python and Jupyter foundation pairs well with Micah's need for developers who can help translate complex ML concepts into intuitive visual experiences, while Micah's decade-plus track record in d3.js, data visualization, and AI tooling (H2O.ai) offers direct mentorship on turning technical depth into user-facing products.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Alex — Alex is a fullstack developer diving deep into machine learning in the Sacramento/SF area, and your work on visual interfaces for ML systems could be exactly the kind of applied challenge Alex is looking to tackle.
